key_moments: Vinícius Júnior capitalized on a Scotland mistake to give Brazil an early lead.

standout_performers.reason: Scored an early goal and was a constant attacking threat.

matches.tactical_summary: Brazil demonstrated clinical efficiency and dominance, securing a comfortable 3-0 victory by effectively exploiting Scotland's defensive errors. They maintained control throughout the match, showcasing their offensive prowess.

narrative: Brazil kicked off their World Cup campaign with a commanding 3-0 victory over Scotland at MetLife Stadium, immediately asserting their dominance in Group C. This strong performance sets an early tone for their tournament aspirations, while Scotland will need to regroup quickly for their next fixture.
